original_error.reason: motion_result_unknown: motion_result_unknown: tcp_connection_closed: server closed the connection

exact_server_connection_close_root_cause: Previous MVP-3D server handled each accepted client in a daemon thread and the ROS2 bridge also created a dedicated stop client. During/after motion, any server-side application exception or response serialization/send error in a client thread returned from _serve_client and closed that client socket, causing the bridge to report motion_result_unknown after the motion request had already been sent.
exact_four_client_sources: ROS2 bridge main TCP client used by get_state
ROS2 bridge execute path sharing or recreating the main client after disconnect
ROS2 bridge dedicated /mvp/stop short client from the previous stop implementation
manual or scripted TCP probe / reconnect attempts from the previous diagnostic flow
server_model_before: multi-client daemon-thread server with max_clients=3, software stop command, motion_stop_event, and per-client threads
server_model_after: single-client sequential JSON Lines server: listen, accept one client, process requests in order on the persistent socket, return to accept only after client disconnect
application_error_response_behavior: move_joints_sequential exceptions are converted to JSON responses with reason server_motion_error:<ExceptionType>:<message>, capped to 300 characters when generated
result_json_normalization: server normalizes dict/list/tuple/numpy-like item/tolist values to JSON-safe Python values before sending
